Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Summary**
 The Software Engineering Lead is a hands\-on subject matter expert, engineering leader and people manager responsible for a cross\-functional team delivering a defined set of products and services. This role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, and people management.
   

  

 The Lead sets technical direction, ensures technical and operational excellence, and partners with Product to deliver business outcomes. Through their direct team; ensures designs have effective architectural and structural oversight, reliable products are delivered. As a peer to a Principal Software Engineer, this role is accountable for engineering outcomes (quality, reliability, security, compliance, cost, and speed) and for cultivating a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture. Analyses and aligns product roadmaps and determines the technical feasibility of future development projects. In addition will provide direction into delivery plans, schedules, raises risks and updated roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountable for ensuring good management to oversee and continuously improve the quality, service, and efficiency of staff, products and processes. Follows and enforces necessary compliance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Culture**
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws
* Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture; resolve conflict constructively; model One\-Team behaviours.
* Provides effective line management to direct reports and acts as an independent escalation point
* Conduct standard HR related duties such as absence management, performance management, disciplinaries, addressing complaints and resolving problem
* Participate in hiring processes, interviewing and develop onboarding plans of new team members
* Ensure all staff are provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible.
* Coach, mentor and support the professional development of individuals, provide with frequent feedback in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently; fostering autonomy and ownership


**Product \& Delivery Excellence**
* Own delivery outcomes: predictability, throughput, quality, and customer value—using metrics (e.g., cycle time, lead time, escaped defects, change failure rate).
* Drive planning, capacity \& dependency management; ensure delivery plans are feasible and transparent.
* Balance product growth opportunities with technical enablement (tech debt, reliability, security) using clear trade\-off decisions.
* Serve as engineering voice in roadmap prioritisation and discovery; ensure requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to architecture constraints.
* Collaborate with direct reports and various stakeholders to support the development and maintenance of the technical roadmap, ensuring roadmap planning is well thought out technically and will be successful
* Proactively surface risks and mitigations; manage external dependencies and vendor/partner engagement.
* Serve as the initial point of escalation for software development issues within the specific area of responsibility leading on
* Manage and encourage new ideas from team members to foster improvements through innovations
* Interface with Product, UX, other technical personnel, or team members to finalise requirements
* Write and reviews portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity
* Work closely with other development team members to understand moderately complex product requirements and translate them into software designs
* Ensure platform and features are compliant


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**
* Align with domain/platform tech leads and the architecture function to drive standards, patterns, and reusability.
* Collaborate with team and domain tech leads on platform architecture, cross functional requirements and complex data models
* Ensure API and integration designs are robust, reliable and fault tolerant, versioned, observable, secure, and well\-documented.
* Ensure sufficient \& relevant technical documentation is available so that any staff can get up to speed quickly with the technical concerns of the product and services leading on
* Maintain a healthy technical estate: modernisation, simplification, deprecations; manage technical debt with a transparent backlog and guardrails, so that the technical burden is kept in equilibrium
* Provide technical assurance for the team: designs, code quality, reviews, and architectural alignment.
* Ensure security practices and standards are adopted within the team leading and acceptance criteria, with regular security testing is scheduled across all products and services leading on
* Ensure suitable dashboards are developed and enhanced to highlight technical concerns, risks and KPIs
* Keep abreast of new technology developments
* Lead system design at scale, using ADRs, C4 or similar; ensure architectural decisions are traceable and pragmatic.
* Champion modern design principles: SOLID, DDD, event\-driven architectures, CQRS where appropriate.


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure zero/minimal downtime deployments (blue/green, canary); enforce release readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices and operational processes
* Own operational readiness: instrumentation, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerts; production “run” quality.
* Define SLIs/SLOs/SLA and error budgets; drive MTTR, availability, and performance targets.
* Lead incident response and blameless post\-incident reviews; ensure actionable follow\-ups and learning loops
* Ensure software is maintained and upgrade as appropriate
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) plans and are well practiced; ensure compliance for resilience and recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).
* Ensure suitable testing is in place for all services and external interfaces managed are performant, scalable, fault tolerant, reliable and future capacity modelling is considered and performance targets are in defined
* Resolve complex technical issues and complete complex bug fixes as necessary
* Own cloud cost awareness (FinOps\-lite): budgeting inputs, cost\-to\-serve, scaling policies, right\-sizing, elasticity.
* Drive performance efficiency: load testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, and scalable architectures.


**Qualifications**
* A polygot with a wide range of experience of different technologies and systems
* Proven experience as a Tech Lead / Lead Engineer delivering software at scale
* Strong organizational and project planning, time management and change management skills across functional groups
* Advanced problem solving and leading/co\-ordinating people across teams as necessary to troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues and get beyond symptoms to identifying root cause
* Focus more on the design and configuration of new systems to meet user requirements than on the implementation, technical support and evaluation of existing systems
* Demonstrable success leading cross\-functional teams through full SDLC to production.
* Experience in systems analysis, design and a solid understanding of development, quality assurance and integration methodologies
* Experienced developing integrated solutions within a broad technical and business context of significant impact
* Experience balancing product delivery with technical investments (security, reliability, debt).
* Experienced in evaluating and participated in competitive analysis of 3rd party software and services
* Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills
* Skilled in stakeholder management and communicating effectively at multiple levels (engineers → executives)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field of work or equivalent work experience \#


**Skills**
* Advanced knowledge of agile software development methodologies (Scrum, XP, Pair programming, 3\-Amigos, DevSecOps )
* Expertise in various development languages and interfaces such as c\#/.netcore, JavaScript (JQuery, ReactJS), Java, Node.Js, Python, Web, MVC, Restful APIs, GraphQL, CSS, Swagger
* Strong knowledge of SOLID Principles, KISS, YAGANI, Design patterns, Domain Modelling, DDD, CQRS, Event Driven Architectures, micro\-services and message Queues, feature toggles, SOA, and software\-as\-a\-service
* Broad knowledge of Continuous Testing, TDD / BDD, Integration Tests, Performance \& Scalability Testing, Instrumentation (Logging, monitoring, alerting, metrics, health checks)
* Strong knowledge of relational and document based data stores, with strong understanding of normalised/dimensional data modelling principles and data manipulation languages including optimisation techniques
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, Security \& Privacy By Design, SAST/DAST, Encryption, TLS, Secure Coding, Threat Modelling
* Strong knowledge of cloud based hosting, IaC, Immutable Infrastructure and container solutions, and cost/efficiency optimisations
* Strong knowledge of Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Source Control, Build Orchestration, Artefact Repositories, Static Analysis, powershell, green\-blue deployments and canary releases.


**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Keep four squads honest about what they can actually ship** 




 You will run the full Scrum ceremony set, including standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retros, for two to three product squads inside a single business unit, adjusting the ceremony rhythm per squad rather than forcing one template on all of them.
 



 You will track velocity, burndown and cross\-squad dependencies, and flag the ones that are actually going to blow a release date versus the ones that will resolve themselves.
 



 You will coach product managers and engineering leads on writing stories that can actually be estimated, and push back when a story arrives with the acceptance criteria still in someone's head.
 



 You will represent delivery status upward, translating sprint\-level noise into a release picture that a VP of Engineering can act on without five follow\-up questions.
 



 This role expects four to eight years of Scrum Master or agile delivery experience, including time spent supporting more than one team at once. You should be comfortable with Jira at an administrator level, know the difference between a blocked story and a slow one, and have said no to a scope change mid\-sprint at least once. A Scrum or SAFe certification helps but is not the bar, the bar is having run this before and having the scars to show for it.
 



**The team you would be supporting** 




 This is a US\-headquartered product company scaling its India engineering hub, hiring this role through Flexiple. The India engineering org is a little over sixty people today, organised into four squads that this role will rotate support across.
 



 Bengaluru, Pune or Remote (India), with a strong preference for candidates able to overlap a few hours with the US product team.
 



 Expect a recruiter conversation, a scenario\-based round on running a multi\-squad sprint cadence, a session with two of the engineering leads you would support, and a closing conversation with the hiring manager.
 



 This application is also kept on file for other delivery and agile\-coaching roles Flexiple is hiring for alongside this one.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**A Hybrid working model**
*We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.*
***What does a Technical Lead do at WPP Production?***
*We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Technical Lead with deep expertise in Sitecore XM Cloud and the broader Sitecore composable ecosystem. As a Technical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping digital experience platforms, leading engineering teams, and driving the technical delivery of enterprise\-scale solutions. You will provide technical leadership across Sitecore XM Cloud, Sitecore AI, Headless SXA, Experience Edge, Next.js, and composable architecture patterns. The role requires a strong focus on solution architecture, technical governance, integration strategy, and the adoption of AI\-driven content and personalization capabilities.*
***Reporting lines and key stakeholders***
*This role reports into the Head of Digital Technology*
**Key Role Responsibilities**
  Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical leadership, architectural guidance, and support across Sitecore XM Cloud and composable DXP implementations.
   

  

  Drive the technical direction, solution architecture, and implementation strategy for Sitecore XM Cloud, Headless SXA, Next.js, and composable digital experience platforms.
   

  

  Establish and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, security requirements, and quality assurance processes across all phases of delivery.
   

  

  Design and deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications using modern technologies such as Next.js, React, .NET, and cloud\-native services.
   

  

  Lead the implementation of Sitecore XM Cloud solutions, leveraging Experience Edge, Headless Services, and modern front\-end frameworks.
   

  

  Design and develop APIs, integrations, microservices, and event\-driven solutions to support composable architectures and enterprise digital ecosystems.
   

  

  Collaborate with front\-end engineers to ensure seamless integration between Sitecore XM Cloud, external services, and customer\-facing digital experiences.
   

  

  Demonstrate strong expertise across the Sitecore ecosystem, including XM Cloud, Headless SXA, Experience Edge, Sitecore AI, Personalize, Search, and Content Hub.
   

  

  Drive the adoption of Sitecore AI capabilities to improve content creation, content operations, search experiences, personalization, and digital engagement.
   

  

  Stay current with emerging trends in composable architecture, AI\-powered digital experiences, cloud technologies, and the Sitecore product roadmap.
   

  

  Provide technical leadership and recommendations on architecture patterns, platform capabilities, scalability, security, and long\-term technology strategy.
   

  

  Work closely with delivery managers and project managers to define scope, timelines, resource requirements, and technical dependencies.
   

  

  Identify, manage, and mitigate technical risks, ensuring successful delivery of high\-quality solutions that align with business objectives and enterprise standards.
   

  

  Support solutioning, and RFP activities by defining technical approaches, estimating effort, creating solution architectures, and presenting solutions to stakeholders.
   

  


**Key Candidate Requirements**
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
   

  

  Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Senior Full Stack Engineer, or Solution Architect delivering enterprise\-scale digital experience platforms.
   

  

  Strong expertise in Sitecore XM Cloud and/or Umbraco CMS, including headless and composable architecture implementations.
   

  

  Experience designing and delivering scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications using modern development practices.
   

  

  Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
   

  

  Strong experience with .NET, ASP.NET Core, C\#, and server\-side application development.
   

  

  Hands\-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
   

  

  Solid understanding of composable architecture principles, headless CMS implementations, and API\-first development.
   

  

  Experience integrating CMS platforms with third\-party systems, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
   

  

  Good understanding of content modelling, personalization, search, analytics, and digital experience optimization.
   

  

  Experience with Sitecore XM Cloud capabilities such as Headless SXA, Experience Edge, Sitecore AI, Personalize, Search, and Content Hub is highly desirable.
   

  

  Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
   

  

  Strong understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
   

  

  Experience with source control and development tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, and GitHub.
   

  

  Understanding of security best practices, application performance, scalability, and enterprise governance.
   

  

  Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams while promoting engineering excellence and best practices.
   

  

  Strong stakeholder management, client\-facing communication, and workshop facilitation skills.
   

  

  Experience conducting architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and code reviews.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
   

  

  Experience supporting RFP responses, technical estimations, and solution presentations is desirable.
   

  

**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Scrum Master & Platform Reporting Analyst, ServiceNow
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Scrum Master \& Platform Reporting Analyst – ServiceNow Platform**
 The Scrum Master \& Platform Reporting Analyst supports the ServiceNow platform team by enabling Agile delivery, facilitating ceremonies, and driving continuous improvement, while also owning platform reporting, metrics, and analytics to support data\-driven decision\-making across the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Facilitate Scrum and Kanban ceremonies for assigned platform streams.
* Support demand management and prioritization, working alongside the Senior Scrum Master on backlog intake and sequencing.
* Remove delivery impediments and support team productivity.
* Coach teams on Agile principles and practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders on planning and prioritization.
* Provide backup Scrum Master coverage across platform streams as needed.
* Prepare executive\-level presentations and reports.
* Fluent English is mandatory, as the role requires daily collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.
* Own overall reporting, metrics, and KPIs, measuring performance improvements and flagging areas that are underperforming.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for senior management, covering backlog health, closure time, and throughput trends.
* Support measurement of ROI for the ServiceNow platform.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or in a similar Agile delivery support role.
* Experience with the ServiceNow platform.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4, ITILv5 or ITSM concepts.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum and Kanban frameworks.
* Experience using Jira.
* Experience supporting technology or platform teams.
* Experience building reports and dashboards for leadership audiences (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow Performance Analytics).

title: Manager & Scrum Master - Embedded Software Development
description:
Manager \- Software Development
   

  

 Are you passionate about leading agile software teams to deliver innovative solutions while coaching and empowering developers to reach their full potential? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.
   

  

 As our new Manager Software Development \& SCRUM Master, you will be managing a software development team while serving as SCRUM Master, driving agile best practices and delivering high\-quality software solutions that support Grundfos's mission of pioneering sustainable water technology. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

 As a key part of the Software Development R\&D team, you'll create impact by Leading agile transformation and software delivery that directly powers Grundfos's next generation of intelligent pump solutions and digital services.
   

  

 Your main responsibilities include:
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as SCRUM Master by facilitating sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions
* Remove impediments and shield the team from distractions to ensure consistent delivery of sprint commitments
* Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable development priorities
* Coach team members and the broader organization on agile principles, driving maturity in SCRUM practices
* Ensure software quality through code review processes, testing strategies, and adherence to engineering standards


 What makes you a great fit
   

  

 Above all, you are a hands\-on technical leader with a strong agile mindset, capable of balancing people management with SCRUM facilitation and passionate about building high\-performing development teams. We would also imagine that you have:
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in embedded software development with at least 5 years in a people management role
* Proven experience as a SCRUM Master or agile coach in a professional embedded software development environment
* Strong technical background in modern software engineering practices (e.g., CI/CD, cloud\-based architectures, embedded or application software)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent agile certification


 It is a plus if you also:
   

  

* Experience in R\&D or product development within industrial, IoT, or manufacturing domains
* Familiarity with scaled agile frameworks such as SAFe or LeSS
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools for automated build, test, and deployment pipelines


 Why you will love working here
   

  

 We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:
   

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.


 We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.
   

  

 Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

title: Technical Program & Project Management Senior Associate
description:
**Overview**
 TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The below client is a global company with shared ideals and a deep sense of family. From our earliest days as a pioneer of modern transportation, we have sought to make the world a better place – one that benefits lives, communities and the planet
   

  

**Job Title: Technical Program \& Project Management Senior Associate**
**Location: Chennai**
**Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days work From Office)**
**Position Description**
* About the Role We are seeking an experienced and highly organized SAP Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of SAP implementation, upgrade, and support projects.
* The ideal candidate combines deep SAP program/project management expertise with hands\-on proficiency in JIRA for agile project tracking, sprint planning, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* This role requires someone who thrives at the intersection of structured SAP methodologies and agile delivery practices, ensuring transparency, accountability, and on\-time delivery across all workstreams.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Play a role in System of Governance in defining and implementing a large\-scale SAP S4 I\-ERP program Lead tactical activities and support overall strategic program objectives.
* Manage the EPICS/Sub Epics/Features for the Product Group in JIRA
* Continuously assess issues, risks and opportunities while assisting with resolution Track scope changes and manage change control processes to prevent scope creep Manage program\-level CRAID (Change Requests, Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Decisions) log Support gathering and review of metrics to support Major releases as well as to track Production Releases like Release on Demand, Problem Incidents etc.
* Support System of Delivery (SoD) quarterly Program Increment (PI) planning and facilitation of events – Logistics, breakout sessions, presentations, workshops, etc. Support and Manage integration points between ERP modules and legacy/third\-party systems
* Prepare Product Teams for Program Increment (PI) planning events.
* Consolidate Product Line Iteration reviews into Product Group Iteration reviews and retros.
* Coordinate, be accountable and ensure Product Teams are progressing, focusing on scope, timelines \& release management.
* Support Foundational Product teams by coordinating Release activities such as Cutover, Testing cycles, training programs and data readiness with Product teams Support resolving PDO and Foundational related dependencies with Product Managers Remove blockers and impediments by ensuring teams are bringing issues to appropriate governance forums Facilitate lessons learned and transition to steady\-state support/operations Lead end\-to\-end management of SAP projects (implementations, upgrades, rollouts, and support enhancements) including S/4HANA migrations, module deployments (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, HCM, etc.), and integration initiatives.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, resource allocations, budgets, and risk registers.
* Own and administer JIRA boards for all project activities — creating epics, user stories, tasks, and subtasks; managing backlogs; configuring workflows, dashboards, and custom fields to fit SAP project needs.
* Manage project governance: status reporting, steering committee updates, RAID logs, and change management processes.
* Drive continuous improvement of project management practices, JIRA usage standards, and reporting templates across the SAP team.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience managing SAP projects (implementation, upgrade, or support) in project management capacity.
* Demonstrated expert\-level, daily hands\-on use of JIRA — including board configuration, workflow automation, JQL queries, dashboard creation, and integration with Confluence.
* Strong knowledge of both Agile/Scrum and Waterfall/hybrid project delivery frameworks.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.


**Skills Required**
* Release Management, Jira, Agile Software Development


**Experience Required**
* Senior Associate Exp: 4 years in IT; 1 years in Program Mgmt., Expert in Proj Mgr


**Education Required**
* Bachelor's Degree


**Additional Information**
* Preferred Qualifications PMP, PMI\-ACP, CSM (Certified Scrum Master), or SAFe certification.
* SAP Activate or SAP certification in a relevant module. Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, JIRA Align, JIRA Service Management, or other Atlassian suite tools (Confluence).
* Experience in the automotive or manufacturing industry. Familiarity with ITSM/change management tools (ServiceNow) alongside JIRA.
* Key Attributes Detail\-oriented with a passion for clean, well\-organized JIRA boards and traceable project artifacts.
* Data\-driven decision\-maker who leverages JIRA reporting to communicate status objectively.
* Strong servant\-leadership mindset with the ability to motivate cross\-functional, matrixed teams.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, evolving enterprise environments.


**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

title: AVP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a AVP \- BA Client Journey Execution, where you'll facilitate workshops to elicit, analyse and document clear. Complete requirements using standard agile methods, tools and visual artefacts to ensure shared understanding. With competitive benefits and opportunities for career advancement, Barclays is a great place to grow your career in the banking industry.
   

  

**Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include**
* Own and continuously improve BA methodologies, templates and tools, providing leadership and quality oversight to ensure consistency and a single source of truth.
* Proactively identify impacts, risks and cross‑functional dependencies, lead complex workshops with senior stakeholders, and support review and sign‑off.
* Partner with product, technology and agile teams to ensure traceability from requirements to solution, oversee change delivery, and realise agreed strategic benefits.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Chennai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
